settings.tab_content: Formed from locally sourced organic riverbed clay, hand-glazed with minerals and wood ash to create individual texture variations.
Fired twice at 1200°C for over 18 hours to guarantee maximum vitrification, making each clay object completely waterproof and shatter-resistant.
Coloured with plant-based botanical extracts and natural earth oxides. Free from heavy metals, lead, or toxic chemical binders.
Individually glazed by hand. Slight runs, glaze pops, and pitting are proof of genuine human craftsmanship and unique aesthetic character.
